entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Hij/zij evalueert problemen inzake informatieveiligheid, stelt veiligheidsbeleidslijnen op en brengt adviezen uit. Hij/zij verricht conformiteitsassessments t.o.v. het veiligheidsbeleid en wettelijke verplichtingen. Deze kunnen een operationeel, tactisch en strategisch karakter hebben. Hij/zij begeleidt veranderingsprocessen op organisatorisch, technisch en procesniveau. Hij/zij werkt op basis van risico-inschatting en risicoanalyse. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Side 4 av 21 Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Ved innlevering skal leverandøren ta stilling til om opplysninger i tilbudet utgjør forretningshemmeligheter, merke disse og levere en sladdet versjon der det er påkrevd. Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Behandlingen skjer i tråd med personvernregelverket. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for at personopplysninger i tilbudet er lovlig innhentet og nødvendige for tilbudet. This section also performs maintenance on AME external fuel tanks, Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks and provides tempo rary storage for Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks. entity_geography.text: Performance Successful performance will be an essential feature of work awarded under the Panel. Poor performance will be identified and raised with panel members and may result in termination of a contract and/or removal from the panel. Evaluation Criteria for Admittance to the Panel Application Requirements The Contracting Authority is using a process similar to the OPEN procedure for the establishment of this panel, therefore, while all interested parties may apply, only those demonstrating that they have the required level of qualifications, experience and technical capacity will have their application considered. In order to demonstrate eligibility, applicants are required to provide the following information: General Information Including the following information: Name of applicant Address Key contact name Key contact email Key contact phone / mobile Website if applicable Other social media platform activities Date of establishment Insurance Requirements Confirmation of insurances in place and commitment to put the following levels in place if successful for the contract: Must provide evidence of this level of cover being in place or a letter from an Insurance company stating that these levels of cover may be put in place if a contract is awarded within one week of the appointment

Meath C15 N67E via email to procurement@lmetb.ie with the following subject heading: Application for Panel Membership for the Provision of Suitable Sites for Adventure Trips for LMETB students. Queries All queries regarding this Panel Application should be submitted via www.etenders.gov.ie. term_value.text: ead/Coach Functie CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach Taakomschrijving De CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach neemt de rol van architect, coach en leider op in het development team. Dit houdt hem niet tegen om met een hands-on attitude in de technische details van een project te duiken. Hij/zij staat in voor het leiden, coachen en sturen van het team dat een bepaalde applicatie ontwikkelt. Hij/zij helpt FIT in het maken van strategische keuzes m.b.t. het applicatieplatform. Hij/zij helpt FIT bij het opzetten van de vereiste technische governance- en projectstructuur. Hij/zij zorgt ervoor dat de timing, de standaarden, het budget, de documentatieverplichtingen, de kwaliteit, enz. gerespecteerd worden. Hij/zij ondersteunt de projectleiding bij architecturale beslissingen, planning, risicoanalyse, kwaliteitsbewaking en technische governance. Hij/zij begeleidt configuratie- en implementatieteams en staat, waar nodig, zelf mee in voor configuratie. De projecten zijn meestal nieuwe ontwikkelingsopdrachten of grote onderhoudsopdrachten voor de organisatie. Gewenst opleidingsniveau Licentiaats-/masterniveau of graduaats-/bachelorniveau, met minimaal 3 jaar relevante praktijkervaring als CRM Senior Architect/Technical Lead/Coach. Gewenste kennis • Uitgebreide kennis

er Service, Sales, Omnichannel, Customer Insights – Journeys, Customer Voice en Copilot- functionaliteiten evenals de bijbehorende integratie-, Dataverse- en Power Platform- functionaliteiten. • Architectuur, governance en solution design binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Microsoft Power Platform. • Kennis van softwarearchitectuurprincipes, integratiearchitectuur en solution governance. • Kennis van de andere Microsoft 365-componenten (SharePoint Online, Power Platform, Exchange Online, Teams, …) en de integraties met Microsoft Dynamics 365. • Projectbeheer en projectmanagement: beheren van prestaties, timing, budget, correcte inschattingen kunnen maken en het tijdig rapporteren van knelpunten, risico’s. • Procesanalyse- en modellering: kennis van modellerings- en analysemethodieken. • Kennis van Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) binnen Microsoft Dynamics 365, Microsoft Dataverse en het Power Platform. • Kennis van Microsoft .NET Framework en moderne .NET-platformen (.NET Core, .NET 6 of hoger) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van programmeertalen (C#, JavaScript, TypeScript) is een pluspunt. • Kennis van Azure-integratiecomponenten zoals Azure Functions, Logic Apps en API Management, evenals REST API's, Microsoft Entra ID en cloudnative integrati

To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. The software shall provide a comprehensive toolset for managing TDL platform specifications, conducting interoperability analysis, and supporting mission planning across the TDL enterprise. 3.0 REQUIREMENTS The Contractor shall provide the following: 3.1 Software Capabilities The provided software solution shall meet the following key performance parameters: 3.1.1 User Interface and Training: The software shall feature an intuitive, modern graphical user interface (GUI) that minimizes the need for extensive training. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. The system's design must be intuitive enough to mitigate significant skill fade for infrequent users. 3.1.2 Automated Data Ingestion: • 3.1.2.1 Standards: Th

nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. This capability must: • Leverage existing platform specifications and issue records to rapidly generate IO analyses; • Assess interoperability in a multi-link environment;

STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi

NLS administers the program nationally, while direct service to eligible individuals and institutions is the responsibility of cooperating network libraries in the various states, the District of Columbia, Puerto Rico, Guam, and the U. Oppdragsgiver refunderer ikke kostnader knyttet til utarbeidelse eller innlevering av tilbud. Deltilbud Anskaffelsen er ikke delt i delkontrakter. Det er ikke adgang til deltilbud. Alternative tilbud Det er ikke tillatt å levere alternative tilbud. Parallelle tilbud Side 4 av 21 Det er ikke tillatt å levere parallelle tilbud. Hver leverandør kan ha ett gjeldende tilbud per delkontrakt. Forretningshemmeligheter og sladding Ved innlevering skal leverandøren ta stilling til om opplysninger i tilbudet utgjør forretningshemmeligheter, merke disse og levere en sladdet versjon der det er påkrevd. Oppdragsgiver behandler innsynsbegjæringer etter offentleglova og forvaltningsloven. Behandlingen skjer i tråd med personvernregelverket. Leverandøren er ansvarlig for at personopplysninger i tilbudet er lovlig innhentet og nødvendige for tilbudet. This section also performs maintenance on AME external fuel tanks, Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks and provides tempo rary storage for Conformal Fuel Tanks, and Weapons Bay Tanks.
